en: Colorized postcard view of a rural road lined with trees and a horse-drawn carriage in the foreground, with fields to the left. In the distance is a small town featuring a church with a tall spire and several tall, square medieval towers, likely part of a castle complex. The scene is calm and pastoral, with early 20th‑century buildings on the right side of the road. German text is printed at the top.
